description: Java class 'EcuDefinitionInheritanceList' that provides static methods to retrieve a list of ECU ROM inheritance nodes from an XML DOM document and ECU definition object, using XPath queries.

classes.name: EcuDefinitionInheritanceList
classes.description: Utility class for retrieving ECU ROM inheritance nodes from XML documents.

methods.name: getInheritanceList
methods.description: Returns a list of ROM inheritance nodes starting from the given ECU definition back to the base.

methods.name: getBaseRomId
methods.description: Retrieves the CAL ID string of the base inheritance definition using XPath.

methods.name: getBaseRomIdNode
methods.description: Retrieves the 'rom' Node element containing the CAL ID.
